title: Signal onramp and SLI contracts for inference signals
creator: Maya Chen
description: Define and implement a unified 'signal onramp' for inference telemetry that standardizes how Prometheus and OpenTelemetry (OTel) signals enter Redwood's metric fabric, and publish SLI contract definitions for latency/error measurement across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Goal is to reduce ambiguity in per-request attribution, ensure consistent histogram/exemplar mappings, and enable stable SLIs that can be computed in downstream rollup layers.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical schema (v1) document is published in Confluence describing metric envelope, required labels, and interpretation for latency/error/histogram metrics
OTel exporters from inference runtime emit the canonical envelope in staging and pass schema validation checks
Prometheus scrape adapter maps legacy counters/histograms into the new envelope and preserves exemplar linkage to traces
End-to-end synthetic test shows SLI computation (p99 latency, error-rate) in staging Grafana with matching numbers from the evaluation harness
Rollout plan exists to migrate 80% of traffic to the new onramp without customer-visible SLO regressions
Backward compatibility shim implemented for older tenants that cannot migrate immediately
progress_updates: 2026-02-22: Kickoff meeting with runtime, telemetry, and console teams. Agreed scope and owner matrix. Action: produce schema draft.
2026-02-26: Schema v0.1 draft uploaded to Confluence (https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Inference+Signal+Onramp+Schema). Asked for feedback from PM and runtime leads.
2026-03-02: PoC exporter added to inference runtime (branch: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/tree/feature/signal-onramp). Basic envelope emitted, unit tests for label population added.
2026-03-05: Design review with Console team — agreed exemplar mapping approach and list of required labels: model, model_variant, route, tenant_id, request_type, client_region, seq_len_bucket.

2026-03-08: Prometheus scrape adapter mapping prototype merged to telemetry-adapters repo (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry-adapters/pull/48). Integration tests failing for histogram buckets — investigating precision loss.

2026-03-10: Decided deterministic sampling strategy for low-volume tenants and established a feature-flagged rollout path. Security review flagged tenant_id leakage; decided to hash tenant_id in metrics and add mapping in private deployments.
decisions: Canonical envelope will be OTLP-compatible metric envelope with a thin Redwood label contract (avoid embedding complex JSON blobs in values)
Map runtime latency histograms to Prometheus histogram + exemplars; preserve trace_id/trace_link as exemplar metadata for downstream linking
Use deterministic 1% sampling for raw traces/long-tail spans for tenants below traffic threshold; ensure sampled traces are denormalized into the metric envelope for attribution
Tenant identifier will be hashed for hosted telemetry to meet privacy requirements; plaintext tenant_id allowed in Dedicated/Private with RBAC controls
Backward-compatible shim: adapters will produce both legacy metrics and canonical envelope for a 6-week migration window
notes: This ticket focuses on the ingestion contract and SLI definitions. Follow-up tickets will handle rollout automation, per-tenant migration tooling, and storage/cost accounting changes. Coordinate with PM to schedule migration waves and communicate developer migration guides.
